notes.4: Evidence is counted in studies: each study gives one verdict per pair (at least 2 untied comparisons, 75% one way). An ordering reversal needs at least 2 other studies agreeing at 80%; two studies that disagree make one two-study conflict. Each study uses one configuration per model; combined configurations are their own systems and are not compared with their members; companion_of joins sources into one study. Scope is same-protocol, same-task, different-task or unknown. Severity is capped by scope, limited to medium below 3 consensus studies, and steps down for unreviewed identity and a variant mismatch; nothing steps it up. See docs/design/discrepancy-rules-v4.html and docs/reviews/2026-10-24-discrepancy-rules-v4.md.
notes.3: Gap outliers are measured against a reference system every study in the group measured, preferring a named baseline, per protocol or task and metric; groups without one are skipped. Disputed results and results under an evidence concern are left out. IDs hash rule, systems, anchor, metric and a stable outlier study key. See docs/reviews/2026-10-23-discrepancy-identity.md.
notes.2: Sources with one DOI, and files from one GitHub repository, are one study; a reversal of a strong consensus goes up a severity step. See docs/reviews/2026-10-22-discrepancy-severity.md.
